sentences.text: Game of Thrones is an American fantasy drama television series created by David Benioff and D. B. Weiss .	David Benioff	David Benioff	D. B. Weiss	D. B. Weiss	fantasy	fantasy	drama	Drama (film and television)

It is an adaptation of A Song of Ice and Fire , George R. R. Martin 's series of fantasy novels , the first of which is A Game of Thrones .	A Song of Ice and Fire	A Song of Ice and Fire	George R. R. Martin	George R. R. Martin	fantasy	fantasy	A Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones
It is filmed at Titanic Studios in Belfast , on location in the United Kingdom , and in Canada , Croatia , Iceland , Malta , Morocco , Spain , and the United States .	Belfast	Belfast
The series premiered on HBO in the United States on April 17 , 2011 , and its sixth season ended on June 26 , 2016 .	HBO	HBO
The series was renewed for a seventh season , which is scheduled to premiere on July 16 , 2017 , and will conclude with its eighth season in 2018 .

Set on the fictional continents of Westeros and Essos , Game of Thrones has several plot lines and a large ensemble cast .	Westeros and Essos	World of A Song of Ice and Fire	ensemble cast	ensemble cast

The first story arc follows a dynastic conflict among competing claimants for succession to the Iron Throne of the Seven Kingdoms , with other noble families fighting for independence from the throne .	story arc	story arc	Iron Throne	Iron Throne (A Song of Ice and Fire)	Seven Kingdoms	World of A Song of Ice and Fire#Westeros

The second covers attempts to reclaim the throne by the exiled last scion of the realm 's deposed ruling dynasty ; the third chronicles the threat of the impending winter and the legendary creatures and fierce peoples of the North .	scion	Lineal descendant
Game of Thrones has attracted record viewership on HBO and has a broad , active , international fan base .	HBO	HBO	fan base	Fandom

It has been acclaimed by critics , particularly for its acting , complex characters , story , scope , and production values , although its frequent use of nudity and violence -LRB- including sexual violence -RRB- has attracted criticism .

The series has received 38 Primetime Emmy Awards , including Outstanding Drama Series in 2015 and 2016 , more than any other primetime scripted television series .	Outstanding Drama Series	Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Drama Series

Its other awards and nominations include three Hugo Awards for Best Dramatic Presentation -LRB- 2012 -- 2014 -RRB- , a 2011 Peabody Award , and four nominations for the Golden Globe Award for Best Television Series -- Drama -LRB- 2012 and 2015 -- 2017 -RRB- .	other awards and nominations	List of awards and nominations received by Game of Thrones	Hugo Awards for Best Dramatic Presentation	Hugo Award for Best Dramatic Presentation	Peabody Award	Peabody Award

Of the ensemble cast , Peter Dinklage has won two Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series -LRB- 2011 and 2015 -RRB- and the Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor -- Series , Miniseries or Television Film -LRB- 2012 -RRB- for his performance as Tyrion Lannister .	ensemble cast	ensemble cast	Peter Dinklage	Peter Dinklage	Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series	Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series	Tyrion Lannister	Tyrion Lannister

Lena Headey , Emilia Clarke , Kit Harington , Maisie Williams , Diana Rigg , and Max von Sydow have also received Primetime Emmy Award nominations for their performances in the series .
